interior_flavor: Nothing there. Jars from tiers you will never hold a permit for, dusted anyway.
Nothing there. Something small breathes behind the bench and decides to keep still.
_comment: COUNTER SHAPE: (3,2) and (5,2) are the counter's two solid ends; (4,2) is NOT in `blocked` and carries no decor because `den_shop_keeper` STANDS in it -- the shipped inn/guild shape (Erin at (7,2) between counter_mid (6,2)/(8,2); Selys at (8,2) between counter_mid (7,2)/(9,2)). `interact` resolves exactly one cell (`entity_at(player_cell + player_facing)`, wi_game.gd:400), so the keeper MUST occupy the cell a customer at (4,3) faces or she is unreachable from the shop floor.

entities.observe: The shopfront door, hung so it swings shut on its own. Past it, the market tier goes back to being civic.
A broad Drake behind a counter worn pale in two places, one where the coins land and one where her elbow goes. Both are hers.
entities.friendly_line: She pushes a bowl of salted something across the counter at you without being asked, and takes the coin for it without apologising.
talk_pool: Sit if you're sitting, {addr}. Standing customers make the hatchlings nervous.
Fourth generation on this tier. Same permit number, four different clerks who each swore it was wrong.
Everything on that shelf came up the lift. Everything. Including the shelf.
I feed this quarter and I charge this quarter. Nobody has ever found that strange but visitors.

entities._comment: P2 SKILL route. Visible-locked (requires_skill), so a player without the arm still sees the route exists.
entities.observe: The workshop's drawings for the oven regulator, ten sheets held flat under a jar. A packing list is pinned to the last sheet.
entities.skill_hint_toast: Every fitting on the regulator is drawn and numbered. Appraise the sheets and the fittings come clear.
entities.locked_toast: Ten sheets of brass fittings drawn to scale. By the third sheet the lines stop meaning anything to you.

on_skill_use.toast: [Appraise Goods] — Sheet nine shows a brass catch that swings a shutter over the rune-plate for shipping. The packing list ticks every fitting on the regulator except that catch.

entities._comment: P2 HELP leg 3 of 3. Variant `when` is (leg index - 1) = 2: variants resolve before this interact banks (interactions.gd:129-138).
entities.observe: A cleared square of floor by the back wall with a chalk outline on it, the size of one crate, waiting since the first cycle.
entities.once_per_waking_toast: The dock is squared away for today, chalk outline and all.
entities.toast: You square the load onto the chalk outline. The chalk goes under the crate on all four sides.

variants.toast: Third leg, last leg. The crate lands inside its own chalk outline and something in the back of the shop goes quiet, then very loud, then quiet again.

entities.observe: Jars in a rank, labels in a hand that got neater partway along the shelf and then went back to how it was.
entities.toast: Tier stamps on the jar shoulders, half of them numbers your permit does not reach. The keeper watches you read them and goes back to her tally.

entities.observe: A bench cut down to knee height, three sets of claw-marks along the front edge at three different heights.
entities.toast: Something small goes very still behind the bench, decides you are not interesting, and resumes an argument you cannot follow about whose turn it is.

entities.observe: The family's own board: who eats here on credit, and for how long. Names in chalk, never in ink.
entities.toast: Eleven names carried. One of them has been carried for two years and has no repayment column at all.

entities._comment: #513 Room on the Row HELP leg 2 of 2. Later-satisfied `variants`: the shelf banks wool_bales_carried only once leg 1 (the market's wool_bale_stack) has, and retires at 2, so the den keeper's [Two bales are on your shelf.] row can only be earned in order. Cell (1,4) on the west wall, approached from (2,4); no shipped QA route and no journey enters the den shop.
entities.observe: A shelf on the west wall, cleared to bare boards.
entities.toast: The boards are bare and still damp from a cloth. A chalk line runs along the front edge.

variants.toast: You set both bales on the shelf, inside the chalk line. Behind the low bench, something small takes an interest.

variants._comment: #513 review item 10: once the stall row has opened (talk route) the shelf stops taking bales, so a half-carried help route cannot end on an unacknowledged shelf. Sits BELOW the carried-2 rung on purpose: later-satisfied wins, so bales already set (carried 2) still read as set.
variants.toast: The boards are bare and still damp from a cloth. A chalk line runs along the front edge.
Two bales of plains wool sit on the shelf, inside the chalk line.
